name: @codegiveness/postgresql-sharp-mcp
description: Database-agnostic PostgreSQL MCP server with live discovery and bounded per-call selection. Installs one platform package with the .NET runtime bundled; no .NET installation or runtime downloads required.
author: codegiveness

scripts.postinstall: postgresql-sharp-mcp-npm-install || (echo postgresql-sharp-mcp: setup did not complete. If npm reported postgresql-sharp-mcp-npm-install as not found or not recognized, npm did not install the platform package for this machine: reinstall without --omit=optional and without an omit=optional npm setting, and delete a package-lock.json created on another OS. Platform packages exist for Windows x64, macOS x64 and arm64, and glibc Linux x64 and arm64. See https://github.com/codegiveness/postgresql-sharp-mcp#if-setup-does-not-work 1>&2 && exit 1)
